(っ◔◡◔)っ 💬 My Blah Blah 💬
Over 4 weeks without an update might have scared you, but let me try to explain without it looking like excuses. You know how momentum works, right? The faster you go, the harder it is to stop. And the bigger the momentum... the smaller pebble is needed to absolutely demolish your speed. With huuuge speed, even a tiny pebble can send you flying in the air.



Now, Amelia gained a LOT of momentum in a very short time and then... Remember the pebble? Let's switch that pebble with an actual rock. That is the shortest description of what happened. I don't want to go into details because I don't really think this is the right time and place to do so. After all, it's a devlog, not my diary :) Long story short: something went BOOM! But now I think I've recovered and I'll try to resume my normal schedule. For the sake of Steam Next Fest I unlocked some more stuff than usual.



Sorry for vanishing like that. Hope you'll understand.

(っ◔◡◔)っ 💬 My Blah Blah 💬Thank you for Feedback!
The Google Forms I set up ended up being a hit. I am getting plenty of awesome ideas and suggestions. Thank you guys! ^-^ To whoever still hasn't paid it a visit, you go do so here:
 ➡️ ➡️ Feature Request Form ⬅️ ⬅️


I will be taking a short break
A week for personal stuff. I still can be reached via discord and such (I am taking my phone with me). I will be just away from my laptop. Hence, UP2 is so big. wanted to leave a lot behind so you won't get bored <3


What's next?
There is a list of requested features I promised I will add, so that takes priority. After that, I will start working on either a new location or the Story mode. OR BOTH XD


Reviews/Score/Comments matter!
I am not telling you to rain sugar on me. But leaving those pushes Amelia up the algorithm ladder. And the higher Amelia is, the bigger the reach the game has. The bigger reach, the more I can accomplish and the more motivated I am to do so.


Thank you! ^-^
You keep supporting me so much and in so many ways. Even via Patreon! Special thx to those handful of heroes who risk supporting me like that. It means huge trust and faith in me. And the more you believe in me - the more I believe in myself ^.^


(っꈍ◡ꈍ)っ 💋 The Good Stuff 💋

notes.title: 👀 Update 1: "Booya"
notes.notes:
(っ●'◡'●)っ 🦄 Update TL;DR 🦄
V0.8.6
🔥 ADDED | Toy: Human Penis.
🔥 ADDED | Toy: Dildo.
🔥 ADDED | Toy: THE Dildo.
🔥 ADDED | Accessory: Glasses.
🔥 ADDED | Customisation: Ability to set the color of an independent accessory/dress piece.
🔥 ADDED | Gameplay: Nipples get hardened with fun. :3
🔥 ADDED | Gameplay: Sweat & Blushing system.
🔥 ADDED | Audio: more ambients tied to day cycle.
🛠 FIXED | Deodorant (default toy) had a bugged texture.
🛠 FIXED | Skin color affecting eyes.
🛠 FIXED | Pilot toy had the wrong axis and position.
📢 INFO | I have to remove the necklace for now. It will come back once I fix it. 
📢 INFO | To celebrate Steam Demo release & first update, I'm unlocking one more Lewd Position and a color in the Demo. 

(っ◔◡◔)っ 💬 My Blah Blah 💬
There is soooo much I want to say right now. But I am trying to figure out how to express all those thoughts so they do not become like a book, hm.
Thank you. Yeah. It all boils down to... Thank you. 
Thank you, my thousands of visitors who strayed nearby.
Thank you, my hundreds of Wishlisting fellows.
Thank you, my dozens of followers.
Thank you, with all of my heart strength. 

Thank you for all the comments, all the likes and subs, all the follows, all the upvotes, every big and every small thing. For every suggestion and every opinion. For every warm smile and every word of critique. I know, I am self-aware enough to understand how cringe all of this is coming out. XD

But you have to understand. A week ago, no one knew about me or Amelia. A week ago, I was your friendly NPC, you just passed by on the street walk. I was making Dreams of Amelia, fully prepared that there are huge chances I will simply bounce off the harsh reality. I was expecting many things.

But never, even for a brief moment, would I dare to think I'll be met with so much warmth, friendship, and support.  I salute you. And I will repay the trust and faith you put in me by making Amelia as great as possible. I am giving my all. 

Of course, reality check click click! - I still have a regular job. So the development of the game still takes time between my working and sleeping hours :P

But now I know I am not wasting time. And that, someone is waiting for me.
No one ever anticipated anything from me. 

So one more time...
Thank you. 

(っꈍ◡ꈍ)っ 💋 The Good Stuff 💋
